notes: World-class audit, Medium batch 1 (v12.09): M7 calculator % now means percent-of-acc for + / - (200 + 10% = 220, not 200.10; x / divide keeps the plain decimal). M8 divide-by-zero is blocked with Cannot divide by zero (no silent wrong save; 100 / 0 no longer saves 100). M9 statement Bal. badge and share text now show the signed balance with To collect / Advance / Settled, so an advance no longer reads as money owed. M11 switching tabs now asks Discard unsaved entry? before throwing away a draft — sales entry, keypad amount, invoice builder, create-contact and create-supplier forms (main tabs and Udhar mode pills). M1 ledger tombstones (DB v11, additive): deleting a ledger row records it, and restoring an old backup can no longer resurrect deleted udhar / supplier / invoice / cash rows or contacts; the restore result reports deleted rows not restored.
